authority.credentials: trusted BFF HostGrant and X-Zebra-Client-Session; never browser secrets
authority.currentTaskScope: agent.run; exact Task/Run and signed subject authority
authority.profile: active Session pinned published Profile; current Host binding when Host context is present
authority.mount: exact Session/UI/Profile/mounted snapshot/RunBinding digest; state and tool names cannot exceed mounted and bound sets

persistence.authority: existing command CAS/idempotency and durable Session event
persistence.observationGuarantee: current registry observations before immutable command admission; no cross-store linearizable revocation or latest UI promise
persistence.redaction: shared native key heuristic, not general value-content DLP
persistence.numericCanonicalization: new admissions normalize negative zero and integer-valued floats from their JSON decimal lexeme; schema checked first; byte budgets checked after; historical hash rules unchanged
